title: Alpha overlays for editing in another app
what_it_does: How to render lower-third cards and kinetic pop-ups with transparent background (WebM/ProRes/PNG sequence) and place them over a cut.
when_to_use: Person edits in Premiere/Final Cut/CapCut and only wants graphics layers.
why: Useful topic, but HyperFrames already has `render` with transparent output and registry lower thirds; write a short note from our own tests instead of copying.
